fixed_buff: I personaggi di apertura avranno PS max, ATT e DIF aumentano del 20%.

mechanics.season_effect_text: After the above characters join your party, Max HP, ATK, and DEF are increased by 20%.

instructions: Act 3 · Knuckle Duckle
A duck-shaped combat machine built from scrap metal and powered by kuuvahki. It is programmed with a variety of strategies.
After the battle begins, it will enter Duckstruction Mode, becoming more aggressive, generating a Ward for itself, and summoning floating Stamping Devices to harass you.

When this happens, you must first deal with the Stamping Devices. Deal DMG with Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reactions, or destroy them directly, to fry their circuits and cause them to attack Knuckle Duckle's Ward instead...
Act 6 · Battle-Hardened Elite Treasure Hoarder
In battle, the Nemesis will summon battle armor from three directions. This armor can enhance the Nemesis.
Trigger Frozen on the Nemesis, or use Overloaded on her, to break her battle armor and prevent the armor from attaching to her.
The Nemesis is enhanced according to the number of armor pieces attached, and should no armor attach, no enhancement effects will be granted.
Act 8 · Battle-Hardened Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network
During combat, the Nemesis will deploy a Suppression Field to strengthen itself and place 4 detection devices protected by Hydro Wards.
After the field is active for a while, the Nemesis will unleash a single wide AoE attack and retrieve the remaining detection devices.
It will then gain a Hydro Ward whose absorption is based on the number of devices retrieved.
Act 10 · Perpetual Mechanical Array
A mysterious ruin machine that can reconfigure itself into various forms.
In battle, the Perpetual Mechanical Array will enter the Absolute Defense state, in which it splits and summons several different kinds of Ruin Sentinels.
After defeating the enhanced Ruin Sentinels, Absolute Defense state will be removed and it will enter a weakened state.
Extra Act 1 · Keep Fighting
Keep fighting until the countdown ends. End the stage with at least one character left standing to successfully complete the challenge.
Each opponent you defeat will take time off the countdown.
Once the challenge begins, all party members will continuously lose small amounts of HP.
Extra Act 2 · Keep Fighting
Keep fighting until the countdown ends. End the stage with at least one character left standing to successfully complete the challenge.
Each opponent you defeat will take time off the countdown.
Once the challenge begins, Electro Bursts will periodically be set off, dealing Electro DMG to your active character.
